seo.title: ODDagency — Creative Strategy & Production in Helsinki
seo.description: ODDagency works with organisations on concept development, cultural context, creative production and project-specific teams built for the work.

title: Bring us something that still needs figuring out.
intro: ODDagency works with companies, cities and institutions on projects that need cultural understanding, concept development and the ability to carry an idea through production. Sometimes we lead most of the work ourselves. Sometimes the right answer is to build a wider team around it.

whenThisWorks.headline: From open brief to produced work.

items.title: The brief is still open.
items.body: You know what you want to change, understand or make possible, but the right format is not obvious yet.

items.title: Concept and delivery need to stay connected.
items.body: You want the people framing the work to stay involved through delivery. The people shaping the concept stay involved through production.

items.title: Culture shapes the problem, not just the look.
items.body: The work depends on how people interpret, participate in or care about something — not only on how it is executed.

items.title: The project needs a team drawn from different disciplines.
items.body: We build the team around the work and agree roles, expectations and compensation clearly.

capabilities.title: Framing & concept
capabilities.body: Turning an open question into a clearer direction, proposition, format or concept before production begins.

capabilities.title: Culture & context
capabilities.body: Understanding the people, communities and cultural context around the work — what is changing, what people care about and what would feel credible to the people the work is for.

capabilities.title: Creative production
capabilities.body: Designing and producing the physical, digital or event-based work needed to make the concept real.

capabilities.title: Participation & collaboration
capabilities.body: Building projects where organisations and creative practitioners work together with clear roles, fair expectations and real value for everyone involved.

capabilities.title: Evaluation & learning
capabilities.body: When relevant, defining what the project is trying to change, documenting what worked and what didn’t, and deciding what should carry into the next phase.

howItWorks.title: Bring the question
howItWorks.body: A brief, a problem or a rough idea is enough.

howItWorks.title: Frame the work
howItWorks.body: We work out what the project actually needs before deciding the format, team or production scale.

howItWorks.title: Build the team
howItWorks.body: We bring in the people whose practice fits the work and agree the budget, roles and compensation before work starts.

howItWorks.title: Make it
howItWorks.body: The team designs, tests and produces the work.

howItWorks.title: Deliver and learn
howItWorks.body: We deliver, review what happened and decide what is worth carrying into the next project.

closingCta.title: Have a project still taking shape?
closingCta.body: Send us the brief, the problem, or the unfinished version.
